title: Curcumin attenuates ulcerative colitis via regulation of Sphingosine kinases 1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Xiuli; Zhang, Hao; Wang, Jingting; Chen, Yangyi; Lin, Jiumao; Wang, Qingshui; Wu, Cheng; Chen, Hui; Lin, Yao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素通过SphK1/NF-kappaB通路缓解溃疡性结肠炎，虽含分子对接但核心是炎症信号通路与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Curcumin, a compound from Curcuma longa L., has significant anti-inflammatory properties. However, the mechanisms underlying its anti-inflammatory activity in dextran sodium sulfate (DSS)-induced ulcerative colitis (UC) remain inadequately understood. This study aimed to further elucidate the molecular mechanisms of curcumin DSS-induced UC mice. Our data showed that curcumin alleviated DSS-induced colitis by reducing intestinal damage and inflammation, increasing goblet cells in colon tissues. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay revealed that curcumin reduced the expression of inflammatory cytokines (tumor necrosis factor-alpha, interleukin-1beta, and interleukin-8) in serum and myeloperoxidase in colon tissues. A comprehensive analysis integrating network pharmacology and RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) revealed significant enrichment of the nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) signaling pathways. Notably, RNA-seq analysis demonstrated that curcumin significantly downregulated the mRNA expression of sphingosine kinase 1 (SphK1). Furthermore, molecular docking analysis showed that curcumin can bind to SphK1 and NF-kappaB. Additionally, curcumin was found to inhibit the activation of the SphK1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway in DSS-induced UC colon tissue. This study addresses pharmacologic and mechanistic perspectives of curcumin that ameliorates DSS-induced UC and inflammatory response.
abstract_zh: 姜黄素（curcumin）源自姜黄（Curcuma longa L.），具有显著的抗炎特性。然而，其在葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的溃疡性结肠炎（UC）中抗炎活性的机制仍未被充分理解。本研究旨在进一步阐明姜黄素在DSS诱导的UC小鼠中的分子机制。我们的数据显示，姜黄素通过减少肠道损伤和炎症、增加结肠组织中的杯状细胞，缓解了DSS诱导的结肠炎。酶联免疫吸附测定显示，姜黄素降低了血清中炎症细胞因子（肿瘤坏死因子-α、白细胞介素-1β和白细胞介素-8）及结肠组织中髓过氧化物酶的表达。整合网络药理学和RNA测序（RNA-seq）的综合分析揭示了核因子κB（NF-kappaB）信号通路的显著富集。值得注意的是，RNA-seq分析表明，姜黄素显著下调了鞘氨醇激酶1（SphK1）的mRNA表达。此外，分子对接分析显示，姜黄素能够与SphK1和NF-kappaB结合。进一步地，发现姜黄素抑制了DSS诱导的UC结肠组织中SphK1/NF-kappaB信号通路的激活。本研究从药理学和机制角度探讨了姜黄素改善DSS诱导的UC及炎症反应的作用。
